long_biography.plain_text:
Construction shaped Giorgetti’s career from childhood, when he accompanied his father to building sites and learned to operate heavy machinery. After studying business management in Paris, he returned to Luxembourg with his brother Paul to confront a family company under financial pressure. They widened its activities beyond contracting into development, building materials, investment management and hospitality, creating an integrated group behind major Luxembourg projects.

A lifelong interest in sailing became Giorgetti’s second industrial venture. As majority shareholder of Solaris Yachts, he has backed the Italian manufacturer’s expansion and the addition of the French builder CNB. His continuing role combines family-business stewardship, hands-on construction knowledge and diversification into specialised manufacturing.
